title: F2: block rule that works without a confidence value; votes averaging; confidence semantics documented
spec:
Every noul answer observed on 2026-09-19 (smoke calls, T-0237 and Planner) came back without a confidence value, so jev_gate's block rule (needs confidence at least 0.6) can never fire and gate_mode=block is inert. Change after F1 (T-0242):
1. orchestrator/jev.py: noul()/ask() keep confidence None when the API omits it; add optional votes (pool.toml [jev].votes, default 1): when greater than 1, ask the same questions votes times in one request (question ids suffixed _1.._n) and average the probabilities, the way jev-compactor's votes option does; record votes in the usage log.
2. orchestrator/jev_gate.py block rule: when confidence is None, decide on probability extremes alone with stricter thresholds: block when P(redundant) at least 0.92 or P(needed) at most 0.08; when confidence is present keep 0.85 / 0.15 with confidence at least 0.6. Thresholds live in pool.toml [jev] (block_redundant_p, block_needed_p, block_redundant_p_noconf, block_needed_p_noconf) with these defaults. Log which rule fired (rule: conf | noconf | none).
3. README Jev paragraph: one sentence on confidence being optional in the API response and how the two rules differ; a note that block mode should be enabled only after a week of log-mode rows.
Tests: tests/test_jev.py::test_votes_averaged; tests/test_jev_gate.py::test_block_without_confidence_uses_strict_thresholds, ::test_block_with_confidence_uses_default_thresholds, ::test_rule_logged.
acceptance: pool.toml [jev] documents votes and the four block thresholds with their defaults; README mentions optional confidence
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
